text: Stop wasting time on random forearm exercises that barely [music] do anything. Let me fix that. You only need two moves. First, wrist curls. Rest your forearms on your legs, let the weight roll into your fingers, then curl it back up and squeeze. [music] This targets the forearm flexors, the muscles that add real thickness to your arms. Second, reverse curls. [music] Palms facing down, curl the weight up with control. This lights up the brachioradialis, the muscle that makes your forearms look bigger from the side and fills the gap between your biceps and forearms. That's it. Two exercises, no fancy routines, no gimmicks, just bigger, thicker forearms that actually show through a t-shirt.
